# Pass Two — Theoretical File Map

The Awtsmoos gives each responsibility one vessel, clean and small;
Awtsmoos.com will remove the language bridge while preserving renderer, validator, and protocol hall.

## Read before touching

- `apps/shared/movie/index.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/AiMovieContract.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieDirector.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieRevisionService.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MoviePromptIntent.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentCompiler.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/planning/*`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieAiRuntime.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieDirectorDock.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieDirectorState.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MoviePromptPanel.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieRevisionPanel.js`
- all five app `installMovieAi.js` files,
- tests referencing prompt/provider/director generation.

## Likely new/reframed vessels

- machine contract/export descriptor,
- data import panel,
- structured patch panel or API,
- data-only state controller,
- agent bridge API for object/JSON/event ingestion,
- contract tests proving no language-derived behavior.

## Files likely removed from runtime/public API

Prompt intent, provider abstraction, prompt feature policy, camera grammar, semantic prompt composer, local intent compiler/director if their only purpose is language-to-movie generation.

Removal must follow import/call-site proof; do not delete by filename assumption.
